changelog: First release: DesignCraft 0.21.1 page layout behind the craft-common bridge.
name: DesignCraft
description: Headless page layout and publishing (DesignCraft from ArtCraft, open source, written in Rust; an InDesign alternative). Creates documents from presets (A4, Letter…) or opens DesignCraft projects, IDML and InDesign .indd/.indt files (converted to IDML), lays out text frames with columns, styles and threading, places images, PDF pages, Word/RTF/Markdown text and Excel tables through the same commands as the desktop app, renders page previews and exports print PDF (PDF/X-4, PDF/X-1a), PNG/JPEG pages, IDML and EPUB.
instructions:
DesignCraft runs headless in your own container; every file lives in /work.

1. Upload the inputs to /work: images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF), PDFs to place as graphics, text (.txt, .docx, .rtf, .md) or Excel tables (.xlsx), or a document to edit (.designcraft, .idml, InDesign .indd/.indt).
2. Create a document: new_document {"preset":"A4"} (also "Letter"…, or "width"/"height" in points; optional "columns", "gutter", "margins", "facingPages":false for single pages). Units are points (72 pt = 1 in); A4 is 595.28 x 841.89 pt with 36 pt margins, x to the right and y down from the top left corner of the first page. To edit an existing file: open_document {"path":"/work/brochure.idml"} (also .designcraft, or InDesign .indd/.indt, converted to IDML; inspect_document lists its pages, frames and stories).
3. Text: execute {"command":"frame.create","params":{"rect":[36,36,559,100],"content":"text","text":"Headline"}} returns {"id":8,"story":9}; \n starts a new paragraph. Typography applies to selected text: select it with execute {"command":"text.select","params":{"story":9,"anchor":0,"focus":8}} (UTF-8 byte offsets; get_story shows the story's length), then execute {"command":"type.char","params":{"attrs":{"size":36,"fontStyle":"Bold"}}} (paragraph attributes: list_commands {"filter":"type.para"}).
4. Images: place_image {"path":"/work/photo.png","x":36,"y":120,"width":523} (height follows the aspect ratio; "frame" places into an existing frame). A PDF page, a text file or an Excel table: execute {"command":"file.place","params":{"path":"/work/text.docx","rect":[36,470,559,806]}} ("pdfPage" for a PDF).
5. Columns: right after frame.create, execute {"command":"object.textFrameOptions","params":{"columns":2,"gutter":12}} sets the new frame's columns (or pass "ids":[frame id]).
6. Everything else is a command, the same as in the desktop app: list_commands {"filter":"style"} (also "type", "frame", "object", "layout", "table"…) — always pass a filter, the registry has hundreds of commands — then execute {"command":...,"params":{...}}, or batch {"commands":[...]} for several ("$0.id" passes the id from step 0).
7. Check: inspect_document {} (frames, columns, stories with "overset": true when text does not fit); render_page {"page":0} saves a PNG of the page into /work and returns its path (no inline image) — download it to look at it.
8. Export: execute {"command":"file.exportPdf","params":{"path":"/work/flyer.pdf"}} ("standard":"x4" or "x1a" for print, "pages":"1-2"); export_png {"page":0,"path":"/work/page1.png","scale":2} (.png or .jpg); execute {"command":"file.exportIdml","params":{"path":"/work/flyer.idml"}} or file.exportEpub. Always export with a path in /work (file.exportIdml/file.exportEpub without a path fail) and use a new file name for every export.
9. Hand the result over: download it from /work with plugin_download_file.

All paths must be inside /work; relative paths resolve against /work. Files are passed as paths only: base64 content is refused. A new MCP session (e.g. after a reconnect) starts with no open document, so save your work with save_document {"path":"/work/flyer.designcraft"} after each stage and reopen it with open_document. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle, so always download the results.

accepts.description: InDesign Markup Language document to open (or place as a page)
InDesign document (.indd/.indt) to open, converted to IDML
PDF page to place as a graphic (not opened as a document)
Plain text to place into a text frame
Word document to place as text
Excel workbook to place as a table

returns.description: Laid out document as PDF (also PDF/X-4, PDF/X-1a)
Page as PNG (export_png or a render_page preview)
DesignCraft document, to continue editing later
